claims.text: Labeled for organ-rejection prophylaxis in adult and peds (≥ 3 mo) kidney, heart or liver transplant recipients, w other immunosuppressants.
claims.quote: CELLCEPT [mycophenolate mofetil (MMF)] is indicated for the prophylaxis of organ rejection, in adult and pediatric recipients 3 months of age and older of allogeneic kidney [see Clinical Studies (14.1)], heart [see Clinical Studies (14.2)] or liver transplants [see Clinical Studies (14.3)], in combination with other immunosuppressants.

claims.text: Boxed warning: pregnancy: ↑ first-trimester loss and congenital malformations; avoid if safer options exist; counsel females of reproductive potential on pregnancy prevention and planning;
claims.quote: Use during pregnancy is associated with increased risks of first trimester pregnancy loss and congenital malformations. Avoid if safer treatment options are available. Females of reproductive potential must be counseled regarding pregnancy prevention and planning

claims.text: ↑ lymphoma and other malignancies, esp skin;
claims.quote: Increased risk of development of lymphoma and other malignancies, particularly of the skin

claims.text: ↑ bacterial, viral, fungal and protozoal infections, incl opportunistic infections and HBV/HCV reactivation; can be fatal.
claims.quote: Increased susceptibility to bacterial, viral, fungal and protozoal infections, including opportunistic infections and viral reactivation of hepatitis B and C, which may lead to hospitalizations and fatal outcomes

claims.text: Neutropenia (ANC < 1.3 K/µL): interrupt or reduce the dose.
claims.quote: If neutropenia develops (ANC <1.3 × 103/µL), dosing with CELLCEPT should be interrupted or reduced
